comment: The division table at Kron.cpp:41-54 counts Omen pulses: 48 for a half note down to 4 for a sixteenth triplet, against 24 pulses per quarter note. The density test at line 80 compares the slider-and-CV figure against a noise value rescaled to 0 to 100, so at 100% every division fires. The pulse length is 1e-3 seconds (line 87). The one-sample mute problem the maker describes in the README is a consequence of the expander message flip and is visible in the code: the mute is read at line 77 before the chain message for this sample has been processed.
